quests.title: Connor's Brew

dialogue.sit: So, I heard someone needs Flaming Flower Stamens...

dialogue.t: Yes, that was a commission I sent out. I must say, that was rather quick...
So, have you gathered the three Flaming Flower Stamens that I need?
Yes, this will do. Please accept this small token from me as thanks for your help.
While I'm not certain if we can brew anything sufficiently special with these ingredients...
But I'm sure that this will be a memorable brewing experience nonetheless.

quests.description: The Dawn Winery’s Connor requires three Flaming Flower Stamens.
